newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ex-MOF official says 120 yen/dlr appropriate level.
newsitem.headline: Ex-MOF official says 120 yen/dlr appropriate level.

text.p: Tomomitsu Oba, a former vice finance minister for international affairs, told reporters on Thursday he thinks that a dollar/yen rate of 120 yen is an appropriate level.

"I thought 127 yen to the dollar was just too weak. I think Sakakibara feels the same way. But Sakakibara and I do differ slightly on forex levels," said Oba, who attended a financial seminar earlier on Thursday where senior Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara spoke.
"I think 120 yen is OK," he said.
"Sakakibara probably has a little bit stronger yen in mind than I do," he added.
